title: Playboy Magazine Lot of 4 1966 1975 1976 1987 James + 1 Random Magazine
descriptionText: The product is a lot of four Playboy magazines from the years 1966, 1975, 1976, and 1987, along with one random magazine. These magazines feature a variety of topics including art, photography, modeling, and more. They are all in English and are part of the Playboy brand known for its collector's editions and first editions. This lot is a great addition for those interested in vintage magazines with a focus on art, photography, and men's interests from the 1960s to the 1980s.
